hero.description: Smart-Curuza ni sisitemu yose hamwe y'igurisha, ububiko n'abakiliya yubatse ku bacuruzi b'Afurika. Ikora nta interineti, isangiza hose.
hero.badge: Ikora nta Interineti • Telefoni igendanwa • Yubatswe ku Bafurika

showcase.subtitle: Waba uri ku kazi ukoresha telefoni cyangwa uri mu rugo kuri mudasobwa, amakuru yawe asangizwa ako kanya.

howItWorks.title: Tangira mu Minota Mike
howItWorks.subtitle: Intambwe 3 zoroshye zo guhindura ubucuruzi bwawe
howItWorks.step1Desc: Fungura konti yawe mu minota 2. Ongeramo izina ry'ubucuruzi, aho uherereye, ubundi umeze neza.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Sikana barikode cyangwa wongereho ibicuruzwa ku maboko. Shyiraho ibiciro, kurikirana ububiko, n'umubare w'ibicuruzwa.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Kora ubwishyu, Emera Mobile Money, genzura abakiliya b'ideni, urebe inyungu zawe zikura mu gihe nyacyo.

features.title: Ibyo Ukeneye Byose kugirango Ucuruze
features.subtitle: Ibikoresho bikomeye byubatswe ku buryo ukora

pos.title: Kwishyuza (POS)
pos.desc: Kwishyuza byihuse ukoresheje barikode, uburyo butandukanye bwo kwishyura harimo Mobile Money, no gucapa resiti ku buryo bwikora.

inventory.title: Ububiko n'Inyungu
inventory.desc: Gabanya ibicuruzwa binini, kurikirana inyungu ku bwoko, kubona impuruza z'ibicuruzwa bike, no kumenya inyungu buri mufuka ukugenerera.

crm.title: Abakiliya n'Igitabo cy'Ideni
crm.desc: Igitabo cy'uburyo bwa digitale cyo gukurikirana ibigurishijwe ku deni, kohereza ubutumwa bwo kwibuka, no kubaka ubudahemuka bw'abakiliya.

security.title: Umutekano w'Ibyuma
security.desc: Igenzura ry'ibyuma ryubatsemo hamwe n'uburyo bwo gufunga, kwishyura bifunguye, no gukurikirana kure ibikoresho bifite ideni.

offline.title: Ikora nta Interineti
offline.desc: Nta interineti? Nta kibazo. Curuza udahagarikwa usangize igihe wongera guhuza.

mobile.title: Mobile Money Imeze Neza
mobile.desc: Emera MTN na Airtel Mobile Money bifite STK Push yo kwemeza byihuse.

sync.title: Gusangiza mu Gihe Nyacyo
sync.desc: Amakuru yawe asangirwa ku byuma byose — telefoni, POS, na murandasi.

language.title: Indimi Nyinshi
language.desc: Koresha porogaramu mu Cyongereza cyangwa Ikinyarwanda. Izindi ndimi ziraje vuba.

analytics.title: Ubumenyi bw'Ubucuruzi
analytics.desc: Igishushanyo cy'amafaranga yinjiye, inyungu, na raporo z'iminsi kugirango ufate ibyemezo byiza.

team.title: Gucunga Ikipe
team.desc: Ongeraho abakozi, genzura ibihe by'akazi, kandi wemeze kwinjira kw'ikipe ukurikije telefoni yawe.

t1.quote: Smart-Curuza yahinduye uko ncuruza. Nzi neza ibyo ngurishije, undi nfitiye, n'inyungu yanjye ya buri munsi — ndetse nta interineti.
t1.name: Marie Uwimana

t2.quote: Igikoresho cyo gukurikirana ideni cyonyine cyantunganiye ibihumbi. Nta bigurishijwe ku deni byibagiranwa. Abakiliya banjye bubaha ubutumwa bwo kwibuka.
t2.name: Jean-Baptiste Habimana

t3.quote: Nkunda ko ikora mu Kinyarwanda. Umukozi wanjye wayimenye ku munsi wa mbere. Igenzura ry'ibicuruzwa rigaragaza ibicuruzwa bikunganira amafaranga.
t3.name: Grace Mukamana

cta.title: Witeguye Gukuza Ubucuruzi Bwawe?
cta.subtitle: Ifatanye n'amagana y'abacuruzi bakoresha Smart-Curuza kugirango bacuruze neza kandi binjize byinshi.
cta.note: Nta karita y'amabanki isabwa • Gutangira mu minota 2

mockup.webAlt: Smart-Curuza dashbord ku murandasi igaragaza imibare y'ubucuruzi no gucunga ububiko
mockup.mobileAlt: Smart-Curuza kuri telefoni igendanwa yo gucuruza
mockup.crmAlt: Smart-Curuza CRM igaragaza igenzura ry'ideni ry'abakiliya n'amanota y'ubudahemuka

merchantCTA.description: Ifatanye n'abacuruzi ibihumbi bishimiye gucunga ibicuruzwa byabo, ibyo bagurisha, n'inyungu za buri munsi bakoresheje Smart Curuza. Nta madosiye akomeye akenewe—telefone yawe irahagije.
merchantCTA.feature2: Cunga ububiko bw'ibicuruzwa mu buryo bworoshye
